what_it_does: This paper introduces QDockBank, a dataset of 55 protein fragments generated using quantum computers (specifically superconducting quantum processors that compute using quantum states) to evaluate how well these quantum predictions can dock with drug molecules. The work demonstrates a first-of-its-kind large-scale benchmark comparing quantum-generated protein structures against state-of-the-art deep learning models like AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 to assess prediction accuracy for drug discovery.
